name: Second brain
blurb: One person's people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading, with where each piece came from.
about: A second brain your agents keep, where every note, task and promise links back to the message it came from. It holds one person's people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading, linked to each other. Agents capture what arrives and tidy what is there, and you review their work on a branch before it joins the record.
